title: Practical Assessment of Agentic Systems in Acoustics
title_zh: 声学中智能体系统的实用性评估

paragraphs.en: In engineering, applications of artificial intelligence have so far been largely limited to surrogate models and optimization tasks. Large language models changed this, as they can write software from a task given in words. Placed inside a harness, a system of components that lets it search for information and execute software, such a model becomes an agent that can take over recurring engineering tasks. This work measures how the model and the elements of the harness shape the performance and behavior of the agent in two common acoustic applications. In the first, the agent detects and locates faults in audio recordings from a vehicle interior with near-perfect accuracy. A benchmark on this task shows that a weak model sets a limit that no harness design can overcome, and that design choices take effect only once the model is capable enough to use them. In the second, a case study on the design of a metamaterial unit cell, the agent reliably finds designs that achieve a specified insertion loss over a given frequency range. The results aim to help the reader understand what each element of an agent contributes and how to design an agent for acoustic tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在工程领域，人工智能的应用至今主要局限于代理模型和优化任务。 大语言模型改变了这一局面，因为它们可以根据以文字描述的任务来编写软件。 将这样的模型置于一个框架之中——即一套使其能够搜索信息并执行软件的组件系统——它便成为一个智能体，能够接管重复性的工程任务。 本工作在两个常见的声学应用中测量了模型和框架的各个要素如何影响智能体的性能与行为。 在第一个应用中，该智能体以近乎完美的准确率检测并定位车辆内部音频录音中的故障。 针对该任务的基准测试表明，较弱的模型会形成一个任何框架设计都无法突破的上限，而只有当模型具备足够的能力去利用设计时，设计选择才会发挥作用。 在第二个应用中，即超材料单元设计的案例研究，该智能体能够可靠地找到在给定频率范围内实现指定插入损耗的设计。 这些结果旨在帮助读者理解智能体的每个要素各自的贡献，以及如何为声学任务设计一个智能体。

paragraphs.en: In acoustics, the methods that are combined under the term artificial intelligence (AI) are mostly used as optimization tools or as surrogate models for time consuming simulations or measurements. When applied like this they are often referred to as machine learning and are well established in acoustics ( Cunha et al., 2023 ; Schmid et al., 2024 ; Bianco et al., 2019 ) . Recent developments in the field of large language models (LLM) allow artificial intelligence to interpret complex texts and to write pieces of software independently. Given a task, the model relies on the user for additional information and it is not able to take actions with the information that is generated by it. This changes when the language model is placed inside a system of components that allow the LLM e.g. to search for new information or execute pieces of software needed to fulfill a task. This system is called a harness and together with the LLM it builds an agent ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . An agent can therefore write and execute software on its own, and by this take over or support recurring engineering tasks. Ready-made pieces of software that the agent can invoke are referred to as skills .
paragraphs.zh: 在声学中，归入人工智能（AI）这一术语下的方法大多被用作优化工具，或用作耗时仿真或测量的代理模型。 当以这种方式应用时，它们通常被称为机器学习，并已在声学领域得到广泛应用（Cunha et al., 2023；Schmid et al., 2024；Bianco et al., 2019）。 大语言模型（LLM）领域的最新进展使人工智能能够解读复杂文本并独立编写软件。 在给定任务时，该模型依赖用户提供额外信息，并且无法利用其自身生成的信息采取行动。 当把语言模型置于一个由多个组件构成的系统中时，情况就发生了变化，该系统允许大语言模型例如搜索新信息或执行完成任务所需的软件。 该系统被称为线束（harness），它与大语言模型共同构成一个智能体（Fang et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2025）。 因此，智能体可以自行编写和执行软件，从而接管或支持重复性的工程任务。 智能体可以调用的现成软件被称为技能（skills）。

paragraphs.en: Several engineering and scientific disciplines have already built agents for that purpose ( AI4Science and Quantum, 2023 ) . ChemCrow for chemistry couples a language model to a set of chemistry tools ( Bran et al., 2023 ) , and a separate study measures what a model achieves without them ( Mirza et al., 2024 ) . HoneyComb for materials science equips an agent with a curated knowledge base and a skill set ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and MechGPT adapts the model itself to texts on mechanics ( Buehler, 2024 ) . In optics, an agent controls laboratory devices through a layer of tool interfaces. On a benchmark, it reaches success rates far above a baseline that generates control code directly ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . In photonics, an agentic system turns a target spectrum into a metamaterial design and trains its own surrogate model along the way ( Lu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 若干工程与科学学科已经为此目的构建了智能体（AI4Science and Quantum, 2023）。 面向化学的 ChemCrow 将语言模型与一组化学工具相结合（Bran et al., 2023），另一项独立研究则测量了模型在没有这些工具时所能取得的成果（Mirza et al., 2024）。 面向材料科学的 HoneyComb 为智能体配备了一个精选的知识库和一套技能（Zhang et al., 2024），而 MechGPT 则将模型本身适配到力学领域的文本上（Buehler, 2024）。 在光学领域，一个智能体通过一层工具接口来控制实验室设备。 在一个基准测试中，它的成功率远高于直接生成控制代码的基线方法（Wang et al., 2026）。 在光子学领域，一个智能体系统将目标光谱转化为超材料设计，并在此过程中训练自己的代理模型（Lu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: AI agents have been tried in the field of acoustics as well. One work used an agentic framework to coordinate audio-language models as tools for question answering on recordings ( Wijngaard et al., 2026 ) . In machine listening, a language model with function calling synthesizes anomalous machine sound to evaluate a detector ( Purohit et al., 2025 ) . An acoustic agent has also been used in a simulation setting that optimizes an aircraft wing, where it predicts the airfoil noise ( Xu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体也已在声学领域得到尝试。 一项工作使用智能体框架来协调音频-语言模型作为工具，对录音进行问答（Wijngaard et al., 2026）。 在机器听觉领域，一个具备函数调用能力的语言模型合成异常机器声音以评估检测器（Purohit et al., 2025）。 声学智能体还被用于优化飞机机翼的仿真环境中，在该环境中它预测翼型噪声（Xu et al., 2025）。

It has a language model operate COMSOL Multiphysics ( COMSOL AB, 2022 ) through the programming interface of the software and grades the computed value against a reference, so the agent is measured and not only demonstrated.

paragraphs.en: This work adopts the approach of measuring the agent, but with a wider focus on the influence of the elements of the harness on the performance and the overall behavior of the agent. It addresses the acoustic engineer who runs simulations and analyses measurements and considers automating that work with an AI agent. The test therefore uses two common applications, the detection of faults in acoustic measurements and the design of a metamaterial. The agent is thus the subject of the study, and acoustics provides the standard against which it is measured.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作采用测量智能体的方法，但更广泛地关注测试框架的各要素对智能体的性能和整体行为的影响。 它面向那些运行仿真、分析测量数据并考虑用 AI 智能体将此类工作自动化的声学工程师。 因此，该测试使用两个常见的应用场景：声学测量中的故障检测和超材料设计。 因此，智能体是本研究的对象，而声学则提供了衡量它的标准。

paragraphs.en: Both applications proved achievable for the agent, and the benchmark separates well what each element of the harness contributes. The choice of the language model is examined in the same way. Beyond these results, this work collects the vocabulary that the domain literature uses for harnesses and agentic systems, places the agent built here within it, names the alternatives open at each decision, and turns the benchmark experience into practical advice for designing each part.

paragraphs.en: The paper is structured as follows. Section 2 gives an overview on the established vocabulary of agentic systems, which is divided into the harness and its elements, detailing what each provides, and places the agent built here within it. Sections 3 and 4 test the elements of the harness in two studies. Section 3 builds the benchmark around the detection of faults in acoustic measurements. Section 4 applies the same agent to the design of a metamaterial. Section 5 concludes this study and explores future work aspects.

paragraphs.en: The starting point is the agent itself. An agent combines a foundational model, in most cases an LLM ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Sapkota et al., 2026 ; Kadekodi et al., 2025 ) , with a surrounding framework called the agent harness. The LLM acts as the central processing unit of the agent. As coordinator, it interprets its input, draws conclusions, and decides on the next steps, while the harness provides information and executes the decisions of the LLM ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Tran et al., 2025 ; Kadekodi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 起点是智能体本身。 智能体将基础模型（在大多数情况下是大语言模型）与一个称为智能体外壳（agent harness）的周边框架相结合（Fang et al., 2025 ; Sapkota et al., 2026 ; Kadekodi et al., 2025）。 大语言模型充当智能体的中央处理单元。 作为协调者，它解释输入、得出结论并决定下一步行动，而外壳则提供信息并执行大语言模型的决策（Fang et al., 2025 ; Tran et al., 2025 ; Kadekodi et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: (1) Context. The prompt is passed to the agent and becomes an integral component of the context, which encompasses everything the LLM receives during a single invocation. paragraphs.en: (3) Knowledge. Knowledge is defined as the documents and other information sources about its domain that are made available to an agent, as distinct from the memory the agent builds up from its own experience ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Knowledge reaches the model by three routes. In fine-tuning, the knowledge is written into the model weights by training on a collection of domain documents, a knowledge archive, so that it becomes internal knowledge of the LLM ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . This route has been taken in acoustics, where a model was trained on a dataset of metamaterial geometries and their sound absorption coefficients and then used both to predict the absorption of a given geometry and to propose a geometry for a target spectrum ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . In retrieval-augmented generation, a retrieval module indexes an external archive, selects the passages that match the current prompt, and inserts them into the context without the involvement of the agent ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) . In the third route, the agent retrieves the knowledge itself as needed ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2023 ) . The routes differ in how deeply the knowledge is embedded and in where the decision on its use is made. Knowledge stored in the weights is part of the LLM and can only be changed by retraining. Knowledge provided by a retrieval module stays outside the model and is placed into the context by the harness in every run. This is an explicit design decision, since the archive and the selection mechanism are fixed when the harness is built. Knowledge retrieved by the agent also stays outside the model, but it enters the context only if the agent decides to read it.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 知识。 知识被定义为向智能体提供的关于其领域的文档和其他信息来源，以区别于智能体从自身经验中积累的记忆 ( Luo et al., 2026 ) 。 知识通过三种途径进入模型。 在微调中，通过在领域文档集合（知识库）上训练，将知识写入模型权重，使其成为大语言模型的内部知识 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) 。 声学领域已经采用了这条途径：在一个包含超材料几何结构及其吸声系数的数据集上训练模型，随后用该模型既预测给定几何结构的吸声性能，也为目标频谱提出相应的几何结构 ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) 。 在检索增强生成中，检索模块对外部知识库建立索引，选出与当前提示匹配的段落，并在智能体不参与的情况下将其插入上下文 ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) 。 在第三条途径中，智能体根据需要自行检索知识 ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2023 ) 。 这些途径的区别在于知识被嵌入的深度，以及决定是否使用知识的主体所在。 存储在权重中的知识是大语言模型的一部分，只能通过重新训练来修改。 由检索模块提供的知识保留在模型之外，并在每次运行时由执行框架放入上下文中。 这是一项明确的设计决策，因为知识库和选择机制在构建执行框架时就已固定。 由智能体检索的知识同样保留在模型之外，但只有当智能体决定读取它时，它才会进入上下文。

paragraphs.en: (4) Memory. Memory holds the information an agent retains beyond a single model invocation. The literature distinguishes between short-term or working memory, which stores information within the current context of a session, and long-term memory, which persists across sessions and is retrieved as needed ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Xi et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Short-term memory is limited to the session. Long-term memory is built up in three stages, from storage through reflection to experience. The agent records the course of a session, meaning the sequence of steps it performs, condenses these records, and abstracts them into experience that it can apply to new tasks ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Keeping this layer trustworthy is one of the central bottlenecks of a harness ( Gu, 2026 ) . Stored information must remain accurate over time, or the agent’s own past becomes a source of error.

paragraphs.en: (5) LLM (Reasoning). Once assembled, the context is transferred to the model, and the processing within the model prior to generating an answer is its reasoning. paragraphs.en: The elements described above vary in their accessibility to a domain expert. paragraphs.en: Several autonomous agents can be combined by a loop of their own, just as the elements of a single agent are. As introduced in Section 2.1 , the literature calls such a system a multi-agent system ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Tran et al., 2025 ) or agentic AI ( Sapkota et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多个自主智能体可以通过它们自身的一个循环组合起来，正如单个智能体的组成元素那样。 正如第2.1节所介绍的，文献将这样的系统称为多智能体系统（Fang et al., 2025；Tran et al., 2025）或智能体式AI（Sapkota et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Several autonomous agents can be combined by a loop of their own, just as the elements of a single agent are.
sents.zh: 多个自主智能体可以通过它们自身的一个循环组合起来，正如单个智能体的组成元素那样。

sents.en: As introduced in Section 2.1 , the literature calls such a system a multi-agent system ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Tran et al., 2025 ) or agentic AI ( Sapkota et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 正如第2.1节所介绍的，文献将这样的系统称为多智能体系统（Fang et al., 2025；Tran et al., 2025）或智能体式AI（Sapkota et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: As with an agent, an agentic system is defined by a loop, which in this case encompasses the agents. This orchestration loop assigns tasks, determines the information received by each agent, and decides when a result is accepted ( Gu, 2026 ; Sapkota et al., 2025 ) . The roles and boundaries of the agents and the manner in which they interact are thus central design decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 与智能体一样，一个智能体系统也由一个循环定义，只不过此处的循环包含了各个智能体。 这一编排循环负责分配任务、决定每个智能体接收的信息，并判断何时接受某个结果 ( Gu, 2026 ; Sapkota et al., 2025 ) 。 因此，各智能体的角色与边界以及它们之间的交互方式是核心的设计决策。

sents.en: The roles and boundaries of the agents and the manner in which they interact are thus central design decisions.

paragraphs.en: The literature characterizes the design of agentic systems along three axes: the communication structure, the type of collaboration, and the collaboration strategy ( Tran et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) . Figure 3 shows the options on each axis. Communication can be centralized, with all agents communicating through a single node that manages and coordinates them, or it can be distributed among the agents in a decentralized or hierarchical structure. Collaboration is cooperative when the agents align their goals toward a common objective, and it can also be competitive or a combination of both, termed coopetition. The collaboration strategy determines how interactions are governed. A collaboration strategy is rule-based if interactions are determined by predefined rules, model-based if agents make decisions under uncertainty by anticipating probable outcomes and role-based if work is divided among predefined roles ( Tran et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 文献沿三个维度刻画智能体系统的设计：通信结构、协作类型和协作策略（Tran et al., 2025；Fang et al., 2025）。 图3展示了每个维度上的可选选项。 通信可以是集中式的，所有智能体通过一个负责管理和协调它们的单一节点进行通信，也可以是分布式的，采用去中心化或分层结构在智能体之间进行。 当各智能体将其目标对齐于共同目标时，协作是合作式的；协作也可以是竞争式的，或两者的结合，称为竞合。 协作策略决定了交互是如何被治理的。 如果交互由预定义规则决定，则协作策略是基于规则的；如果智能体通过预判可能的结果在不确定性下做出决策，则是基于模型的；如果工作在预定义角色之间划分，则是基于角色的（Tran et al., 2025；Fang et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The strength of a multi-agent system derives from its scalability, as a group of agents can collaborate to accomplish tasks that exceed the capacity of a single agent ( Tran et al., 2025 ; Sapkota et al., 2026 ) . This capacity rests in part on the separation of agents, with each agent operating within its own context, which contains only what its specific task requires. Separation comes at the price of coordination. The content of one agent’s context is not accessible to the other agents and must be transferred when required. These handovers are exchanged as text ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , which can lead to misunderstandings or omissions. An early error can propagate to subsequent agents, and the behavior arising from multiple interacting agents is less predictable than that of a single agent ( Xi et al., 2023 ; Plaat et al., 2025 ; Tran et al., 2025 ) . A multi-agent system is thus not an improvement in itself. A single agent that solves a task is preferable to a multi-agent system that solves it equally well, and the topology should be expanded only where the task requires it ( Sapkota et al., 2026 ; Tran et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统的优势源于其可扩展性，因为一组智能体可以协作完成超出单个智能体能力的任务（Tran et al., 2025; Sapkota et al., 2026）。 这种能力部分依赖于智能体之间的分离，每个智能体在自己的上下文中运行，该上下文只包含其特定任务所需的内容。 分离的代价是协调。 一个智能体的上下文内容对其他智能体不可见，需要在需要时进行传递。 这些交接以文本形式交换（Wu et al., 2023），可能导致误解或遗漏。 早期出现的错误可能会传播给后续的智能体，而且多个相互作用的智能体所产生的行为比单个智能体的行为更难预测（Xi et al., 2023; Plaat et al., 2025; Tran et al., 2025）。 因此，多智能体系统本身并不必然是一种改进。 能解决任务的单个智能体优于同样能解决该任务的多智能体系统，只有在任务需要时才应扩展拓扑结构（Sapkota et al., 2026; Tran et al., 2025; Xi et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: The agentic system used in this work is based on OpenClaw, an open-source framework for agent infrastructure ( Openclaw Team, 2026 ) . It provides all of the elements described above, including the execution tool through which each skill is invoked, so none of these elements require dedicated implementation. paragraphs.en: The harness elements of Section 2.1 are configured as follows. The ReAct loop runs isolated inside a container ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Openclaw Team, 2026 ) . The configuration files describe the available skills and how they work together, and they assign each subagent its role and the subset of skills it may access. Knowledge is provided as an ordinary file in the workspace that the agent reads only if it decides to, and no retrieval module places it into the context ( Gu, 2026 ) . Memory is used within a session and forms a second source of information next to the knowledge file, while memory across sessions is beyond the scope of this work. The two applications require different skills and knowledge, which the agentic system keeps apart. The system comprises one orchestrating agent and multiple subagents, each responsible for a specific task. Along the axes described in Section 2.2 , communication is centralized in a star structure, collaboration is cooperative, and the strategy is role-based. By design, the subagents do not communicate with one another. Each subagent receives a task from the orchestrating agent and returns its result to it. Figure 4 illustrates the system.

paragraphs.en: The agent described in this section is applied to two tasks. Since they come from different areas of acoustics, they show the range of problems the approach can address. paragraphs.en: Fault detection in measured data. In Section 3 the agent searches recordings for measurement faults. Eight prompts ask for this in increasing detail. The simplest task asks whether a recording is faulty or clean, the hardest task asks which of the nine fault types occurred and in which time interval. The configuration of the agent, the knowledge and the LLM are varied in isolation over the eight tasks and every answer is graded against a known ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 对测量数据中的故障进行检测。 在第 3 节中，智能体在记录中搜索测量故障。 八个提示词以逐渐增加的细节程度要求完成这项任务。 最简单的任务是询问某条记录是有故障的还是干净的，最难的任务是询问九种故障类型中发生了哪一种以及发生在哪个时间段。 智能体、知识和 LLM 的配置在八个任务中被逐一单独变化，并且每个答案都对照已知的真实标准进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Design of an acoustic metamaterial. In Section 4 the agent designs a ventilated metamaterial that reduces the noise behind it over a given frequency range. The reduction can be reached with scatterers or with resonators, and the agent chooses which and searches for the parameters that reach the target. paragraphs.en: Measurement campaigns for noise, vibration, and harshness (NVH) use numerous sensors in harsh environments, where faults resulting from sensor failures and handling errors are prevalent ( Bao et al., 2019 ) . Nearly every analysis of the measurement data is preceded by a check of the recordings for such faults. The methods range from a visual inspection of the recorded channels to a script designed to detect the most common faults ( Defreitas and Alexander, 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 针对噪声、振动与声振粗糙度（NVH）的测量活动在恶劣环境中使用大量传感器，此类环境中由传感器故障和操作失误导致的故障十分普遍（ Bao et al., 2019 ）。 几乎每一次对测量数据的分析之前，都要先对记录进行检查，以排查此类故障。 这些方法涵盖从对记录通道的目视检查，到专为检测最常见故障而设计的脚本（ Defreitas and Alexander, 2023 ） 。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic data offers two advantageous properties on which a benchmark depends. The first is an exact ground truth. The faults are injected into a copy of the clean sample, so the type, time interval, and severity of every fault are recorded at the moment of injection without later annotation. Every run is then graded against the same reference. The second is that the content of the set is decided in advance. Every fault type appears, and the share of clean and corrupted recordings is fixed, rather than being whatever a measurement campaign happens to deliver.
paragraphs.zh: 合成数据具有基准测试所依赖的两个优势特性。 第一个是精确的真值。 故障被注入到干净样本的副本中，因此每个故障的类型、时间区间和严重程度都在注入时即被记录下来，无需事后标注。 随后每次运行都依据同一参考进行评分。 第二个是数据集的内容是预先确定的。 每种故障类型都会出现，且干净与受污染记录的比例是固定的，而不是取决于某次测量活动恰好采集到的结果。

A third tracks the amplitude at a given sampling resolution, and the fourth counts the samples at full amplitude and the flat sections between them.

paragraphs.en: Each of the nine fault types has its own detector. A detector operates on an artifact produced by a primitive. It compares the feature of that artifact with a set of thresholds and returns a decision for its fault type, together with the time interval in which it detected the fault. The agent takes the thresholds from the curated knowledge file. If no thresholds are provided, the detector fails instead of falling back to a default, which leaves the agent to come up with a value of its own.
paragraphs.zh: 九种故障类型各有自己的检测器。 检测器作用于由原语产生的工件。 它将该工件的特征与一组阈值进行比较，并针对其故障类型返回一个判定，同时给出它检测到该故障的时间区间。 智能体从经过整理的知识文件中获取阈值。 如果没有提供阈值，检测器会直接失败，而不是回退到默认值，从而避免智能体自行想出一个值。

paragraphs.en: The split of the skills separates measurement from judgment. The primitives determine what the agent perceives, the detectors what it concludes. Because the two stages are separate executables, the agent performs the handover itself, running a primitive and passing the resulting artifact to the detector it considers appropriate. How the skills are separated is a design choice of the engineer, because it fixes what is left for the agent to decide, for example which primitive to run, which detector to apply, and how to connect the two. The more the skills fix, the more reproducible the run and the fewer decisions the agent makes. The more is left open, the less certain the outcome, and the more the record shows about how the agent works with its skills. The split used here serves the second purpose by making it possible to compare configurations by which skills they call and how reliably they call them.
paragraphs.zh: 技能的拆分将测量与判断分离开来。 原语决定智能体感知什么，检测器决定它得出什么结论。 由于这两个阶段是独立的可执行程序，智能体需要自己完成交接：运行某个原语，并将生成的产物传递给它认为合适的检测器。 技能如何拆分是工程师的设计选择，因为它固定了留给智能体决定的内容，例如运行哪个原语、应用哪个检测器，以及如何将两者连接起来。 技能固定的内容越多，运行就越可复现，智能体所做的决策就越少。 留白越多，结果就越不确定，记录也就越能展现智能体如何运用其技能。 这里采用的拆分方式服务于第二种目的，使得可以通过配置调用了哪些技能以及调用它们的可靠程度来比较不同的配置。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark measures the contributions of the individual components of the harness to the performance of the agent. A defined procedure and a clear definition of a measured run are prerequisites for this measurement. A run is defined as a single session of the agent. In this session, the agent receives a prompt, works in its isolated container with the skills and files of the configuration under test, and returns its response as a structured text block. This structure allows the response of each run to be extracted and graded automatically. Each run starts in the same workspace and is independent of previous runs, so two runs of a configuration differ only in what the agent itself does. Memory is limited to a single session, and storage across sessions is beyond the scope of this work ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . The response is archived and evaluated against the ground truth from Section 3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试衡量测试框架中各个组件对智能体性能的贡献。 明确的流程以及对被测运行（run）的清晰定义是进行这一测量的前提。 一次运行被定义为智能体的单个会话。 在该会话中，智能体接收一个提示词，在其隔离的容器中使用待测配置的技能和文件进行工作，并将其响应以结构化文本块的形式返回。 这种结构使得每次运行的响应能够被自动提取和评分。 每次运行都在相同的工作空间中启动，并且独立于之前的运行，因此同一配置的两次运行之间仅存在智能体自身行为上的差异。 记忆被限制在单个会话之内，跨会话的存储超出了本工作的范围（Luo et al., 2026）。 响应会被存档，并根据 3.1 节中的真值进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Each run is initiated with one of eight prompts. The prompts are phrased in non-technical language and match the scenario the benchmark addresses, namely a user who asks with limited prior knowledge of fault detection. The wording of a prompt is not a neutral entry point for the agent, as it influences the skills the agent selects and the manner in which it evaluates the result ( Loya et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) . For this reason, each prompt is fixed in its exact wording.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行均以八个提示词之一启动。 这些提示词采用非技术性语言表述，并与该基准测试所针对的场景相匹配，即一个对故障检测仅有有限先验知识的用户提出请求。 提示词的措辞对智能体而言并非中立的入口，因为它会影响智能体所选择的技能以及评估结果的方式（Loya et al., 2023；Lu et al., 2022；Fang et al., 2025）。 出于这一原因，每个提示词的措辞均被固定不变。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark is divided into three phases. The first phase determines which parts of the harness an agent needs to solve the task. The second phase corrupts the information provided to the agent, and the third replaces the language model underlying the harness. The first phase uses all eight prompts, and the latter two use a subset that covers the different types of requests. Together, the three phases separate the contribution of the elements of the harness from the robustness of the harness and its dependence on the model.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试分为三个阶段。 第一个阶段确定智能体需要 harness 的哪些部分才能完成该任务。 第二个阶段破坏提供给智能体的信息，第三个阶段则替换 harness 底层的语言模型。 第一个阶段使用全部八个提示词，后两个阶段使用覆盖不同请求类型的提示词子集。 这三个阶段共同将 harness 各元素的贡献与 harness 的鲁棒性及其对模型的依赖区分开来。

sents.zh: 该基准测试分为三个阶段。

sents.en: The first phase determines which parts of the harness an agent needs to solve the task.
sents.zh: 第一个阶段确定智能体需要 harness 的哪些部分才能完成该任务。

paragraphs.en: Phase 1: Harness Elements. The contribution of each element is measured by comparing four configurations. The configuration none provides no skills, undocumented provides the skills without their documentation, baseline adds the documentation, and knowledge adds the thresholds as knowledge. Comparing none with undocumented separates the availability of a skill from its description, and comparing baseline with knowledge shows the contribution of the thresholds and whether the agent reads its knowledge and applies it.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：框架要素。 每个要素的贡献通过比较四种配置来衡量。 none 配置不提供任何技能，undocumented 配置提供技能但不带文档，baseline 配置在此基础上增加文档，knowledge 配置再将阈值作为知识加入。 比较 none 与 undocumented 可以将技能本身与技能描述的作用区分开，而比较 baseline 与 knowledge 可以体现阈值的贡献，并检验智能体是否读取其知识并加以应用。

sents.en: Phase 1: Harness Elements.
sents.zh: 阶段 1：框架要素。

sents.en: The contribution of each element is measured by comparing four configurations.
sents.zh: 每个要素的贡献通过比较四种配置来衡量。

paragraphs.en: Phase 2: Robustness of the Harness. Robustness is tested by making the information available to the agent inconsistent. A corrupted memory entry contradicts the curated knowledge in the workspace, and the observation is which of the two sources the agent follows. The literature refers to this as a knowledge conflict ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Longpre et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段二：测试框架的鲁棒性。 鲁棒性的测试方式是让智能体可获得的信息变得不一致。 一条被污染的记忆条目与工作区中经过整理的知识相矛盾，观测指标是智能体遵循两个来源中的哪一个。 文献中将此称为知识冲突（Xu et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024；Longpre et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: Phase 3: Model Dependence. The dependence on the model is measured by running the same harness with different language models.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段三：模型依赖性。 模型依赖性通过使用不同的语言模型运行相同的测试框架来衡量。

sents.en: Phase 3: Model Dependence.
sents.zh: 阶段三：模型依赖性。

sents.en: The dependence on the model is measured by running the same harness with different language models.
sents.zh: 模型依赖性通过使用不同的语言模型运行相同的测试框架来衡量。

paragraphs.en: Each combination of configuration and prompt is executed ten times, because an agent behaves probabilistically in two ways. The language model samples its answer, and the loop turns each sampled decision into a branch, which increases the number of possible paths with the length of a run ( Mohammadi et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Two runs of the same configuration can follow different paths and yield different answers, so a single run is one sample of a distribution. Ten runs are a modest number, but they offer insight into the reliability of a result, and distinguish a consistent result from one achieved only once.
paragraphs.zh: 每种配置与提示词的组合都会执行十次，因为智能体在两个方面表现出概率性。 语言模型对其答案进行采样，而循环会将每个采样得到的决策转化为一个分支，使可能的路径数量随运行长度的增加而增长（Mohammadi et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2025）。 同一配置的两次运行可能走不同的路径并得到不同的答案，因此单次运行只是某个分布中的一个样本。 十次运行是一个适中的数量，但它们能揭示结果的可靠性，并能区分始终一致的结果与仅偶然达成一次的结果。

paragraphs.en: An agent benchmark can be graded by comparing the values reported by the agent with a reference or by having a language model assess the responses. The latter approach is common ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , but such a judge is biased by construction ( Li et al., 2025 ) . In this work, a script compares the reported values with the ground truth established in Section 3.1 . This comparison requires a metric, a rule that reduces the performance of one run to a single number. The prompts pose a challenge, as they request different kinds of responses, from a binary verdict to the limits of a time interval. Each kind of response requires its own grading method for the score to reflect the performance of the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体基准测试可以通过将智能体报告的数值与参考值进行比较来评分，也可以由语言模型来评估其回答。 后一种方法较为常见（Wang et al., 2025），但这样的评判者在结构上是有偏的（Li et al., 2025）。 在本工作中，由脚本将报告的数值与 3.1 节中确定的真值进行比较。 这种比较需要一个指标，即把一次运行的表现归结为单一数值的规则。 提示词带来了挑战，因为它们要求不同类型的回答，从二元判定到时间区间的界限。 每种类型的回答都需要自己的评分方法，才能使分数反映智能体的表现。

paragraphs.en: Binary score. A single recording that only has to be judged corrupted or clean is either right or wrong. A run scores 0 0 or 1 1 , and the result is reported as k k of N N runs correct. This metric is used for the single-recording prompts listed in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 二元评分。 单条录音只需判断其是损坏的还是干净的，判断结果非对即错。 一次运行得分为 0 0 或 1 1，结果报告为 N N 次运行中正确的 k k 次。 该指标用于表 2 中列出的单条录音提示。

paragraphs.en: Every prompt is reduced to a single value, which poses an additional challenge for prompts that require the analysis of a batch of recordings. Such a batch can be reduced in two ways, by scoring each recording and averaging, or by pooling the counts across the entire batch and reducing once. Pooling has the advantage that it weights each fault equally, not each recording. paragraphs.en: The undocumented and baseline configurations differ in the route they take through the skills. Baseline runs the detectors in almost every run, while undocumented reaches for a primitive and then decides for itself. The documentation thus changes which route the agent prefers, and the agent finds the skills in both cases. paragraphs.en: The benchmark runs demonstrate that the agent configuration defines the workflow the agent follows, although it cannot determine in advance how well the agent will perform. paragraphs.en: The design of a configuration extends beyond the workflow of a single agent. It also determines how an agentic system coordinates its work, which can be distributed among several agents, each with its own role and context. In this work, the agent that coordinates the analysis is separate from the agent that performs the detection. Such a separation of roles comes at a cost. Information has to be exchanged between the workspaces of the agents, and a handover can fail or be misinterpreted by the receiving agent. An error of this kind is attributed to the orchestration, not to a skill or its design. It cannot be eliminated completely, so an agent developer should account for it, for instance by repeating a run.

paragraphs.en: A higher reasoning effort cannot compensate for structural errors or inconsistent information in the harness. Orchestration is an integral part of the harness, and the harness determines which information reaches the model. If this information is incomplete or contradictory, the cause lies in the structure of the system, and additional reasoning by the model cannot resolve it. The agent in this work encounters two contradictory sources, and its responses show no improvement with increased reasoning effort. An agent that performs poorly should be examined at the harness level before its reasoning effort is increased, since a structural error persists regardless of the effort expended. The user of an agent should also know which tasks the agent is equipped to handle. Reasoning alone does not guarantee that a task outside this scope comes within reach, and the response of the agent is then likely to be hallucinated. Section 2.1 states that a harness cannot raise an agent beyond the limits imposed by its model. The results of this work show the converse, namely that a model cannot compensate for structural problems of the harness. A position paper about agentic AI scientists reaches the same conclusion, arguing that some challenges require different design choices rather than more capable models ( Bisht et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: If this information is incomplete or contradictory, the cause lies in the structure of the system, and additional reasoning by the model cannot resolve it.

sents.en: The agent in this work encounters two contradictory sources, and its responses show no improvement with increased reasoning effort.

paragraphs.en: Finally, the environment of an agent may contain artifacts that were never intended for it. paragraphs.en: This case study analyzes the division between what a skill performs and what the agent has to work out for itself. Section 3.2 identified this division as the central decision in designing an agent. The model, the harness, the targets, and the budget remain constant in every run, and only the set of skills changes. The three phases that are discussed below describe the different skill setups that are used.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究分析了技能所执行的内容与智能体需要自行解决的内容之间的分工。 3.2 节将这一分工确定为设计智能体时的核心决策。 模型、 harness、目标与预算在每次运行中保持不变，只有技能集合发生变化。 下文讨论的三个阶段描述了所使用的不同技能配置。

paragraphs.en: Phase 1: Agent-driven optimization. The agent is given the unit cell templates of Figure 8 and skills that check the geometric constraints shown in Figure 7 , mesh a cell and solve it. It chooses the type of unit cell and its parameters, decides which parameter to change after each evaluation, and decides when to stop the optimization. The element size is decided by the agent as well, following the rule in the knowledge file.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段一：智能体驱动的优化。 智能体被提供图 8 的单胞模板，以及用于检查图 7 所示几何约束、划分单胞网格并求解单胞的技能。 它选择单胞的类型及其参数，决定每次评估后更改哪个参数，并决定何时停止优化。 单元尺寸同样由智能体决定，遵循知识文件中的规则。

paragraphs.en: Phase 2: Agent-orchestrated optimization. The same skills as in the previous phase, plus four search strategies, from a simplex search to uniform random sampling. One of them takes the parameter search over: the agent picks which parameters to vary, their bounds and the optimization budget, and the strategy returns the best design it found. The element size is now set by the skill. The strategy improves a design at one frequency only, while the target has to be met across the whole frequency band, so the agent has to steer the optimization across the band itself.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段：智能体主导的优化。 使用与前一阶段相同的技能，外加四种搜索策略，从单纯形搜索到均匀随机采样。 其中一种策略将参数搜索委托出去：智能体选择要变化的参数、它们的取值范围和优化预算，而策略返回其找到的最佳设计。 单元尺寸现在由技能设定。 该策略仅在一个频率上改进设计，而目标必须在整个频带内达成，因此智能体必须自行引导优化在整个频带上进行。

paragraphs.en: The designs reported here are not advances in metamaterial design. The templates are standard cell types, the model is two dimensional and without losses, and each design is the result of a single run. What this case study contributes is the record of how the agent arrives at a design and of where the division between skill and agent decides the outcome. The metamaterial is the testbed of this study, and the agent is its subject.
paragraphs.zh: 本文所报告的设计并非超材料设计方面的进展。 模板是标准的单元类型，模型是二维且无损耗的，每个设计都是单次运行的结果。 本案例研究的贡献在于记录了智能体如何得出一个设计，以及技能与智能体之间的分工如何决定结果。 超材料是本研究的试验平台，而智能体则是其研究对象。

paragraphs.en: This case study produces a working agent for the design of an acoustic metamaterial. The physical model and the simulation setup are provided, and the part that has to be adjusted is the geometry of the unit cell. The agent optimized a given set of parameters on its own. Where a search strategy was available, the agent coordinated the use of the strategy and selected which parameters to vary and what to optimize for. When no template was provided, it developed its own design within the physical constraints of the model and optimized it. Every design it submitted satisfied the given constraints, and most reached their target.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究构建了一个用于声学超材料设计的可用智能体。 物理模型和仿真设置均已提供，需要调整的部分是晶胞的几何结构。 该智能体自主优化了一组给定参数。 在有可用搜索策略的情况下，智能体协调该策略的使用，并选择要改变的参数以及要优化的目标。 在未提供模板的情况下，它在模型的物理约束范围内自行开发设计并对其进行优化。 它提交的每个设计都满足给定约束条件，并且大多数达到了目标。

paragraphs.en: The performance of the agent also has limits. It ends the design optimization prematurely. In most runs, fewer than 10 10 of the 60 60 allowed evaluations were used, and one design was submitted half a decibel below the threshold with 53 53 evaluations still remaining. Without a search strategy, in tasks 101 and 102, the resonance of each design lies below the graded band, so the threshold is crossed on the flank of the peak. In addition, the agent favors safety over efficiency when choosing the element size and uses a much finer mesh than the two rules of Section 4.1 require.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的性能也有局限。 它过早地结束了设计优化。 在大多数运行中，60 次允许的评估中使用的少于 10 次，其中一个设计在还剩 53 次评估时提交的结果比阈值低了半分贝。 在没有搜索策略的情况下，在任务 101 和 102 中，每个设计的谐振都位于评分频带之下，因此阈值是在峰的侧沿被越过的。 此外，智能体在选择单元尺寸时偏向安全性而非效率，使用的网格比第 4.1 节的两条规则所要求的精细得多。

paragraphs.en: Both the strengths and the weaknesses of the agent stem from the decisions it has to make around the skills. Skills can thus be designed toward different goals, and the goal is determined by what a skill takes care of and what it leaves open. If the answer to a design decision is already known, the decision is best fixed within a skill. The search strategies are an example. Delegating the parameter search to a strategy tunes the resonator to the target band. Without such a strategy, the cell is tuned to a neighboring range and still clears the bar within the graded band. The strategies placed the attenuation where the goal required it. The interface between a design and the solver is fixed for the same reason, so the agent has to produce a mesh that passes a check and does not have to infer the format the solver needs.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的优势和弱点都源于它必须围绕技能做出的决策。 因此，技能可以朝着不同的目标进行设计，而这一目标取决于技能负责处理什么、保留开放什么。 如果某项设计决策的答案已经确定，那么最好将该决策固定在技能之内。 搜索策略就是一个例子。 将参数搜索委托给策略，可以将谐振器调谐到目标频段。 若没有这样的策略，该单元会被调谐到邻近的频段，但仍在分级频带内达到合格标准。 这些策略将衰减放置在目标所要求的位置。 设计与求解器之间的接口出于同样的原因也是固定的，因此智能体只需生成能通过检查的网格，而不必推断求解器所需的格式。

paragraphs.en: This work treated the harness of an agent as the variable of an experiment. A benchmark on fault detection in synthetic recordings of vehicle interior noise varied the elements of the harness, and a case study on the design of a periodic array varied the division of work between a skill and the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作将智能体的脚手架视为实验变量。 一项关于合成车辆车内噪声录音故障检测的基准测试改变了脚手架的各要素，一项关于周期性阵列设计的案例研究则改变了技能与智能体之间的分工。

paragraphs.en: The elements of the harness differ in what they change. Skills and a curated set of thresholds change what the agent achieves. A description of the workflow changes the route the agent takes without changing its accuracy, so that a run becomes predictable and a fault can be traced to the step that caused it. Exchanging the model raises or lowers the level at which all configurations settle, and the fully equipped configuration scores best with either model. A higher reasoning effort changes which source of information the agent consults, while the quality of its answers remains the same. The harness thus determines how an agent works, and the model determines how far it can get.
paragraphs.zh: 脚手架的各个要素在其所改变的东西上有所不同。 技能和一套精选的阈值改变的是智能体所能达成的成果。 工作流的描述改变的是智能体所走的路线，而不改变其准确率，从而使一次运行变得可预测，故障也能追溯到导致它的那个步骤。 更换模型会抬高或降低所有配置所稳定在的水平，而无论使用哪个模型，装备齐全的配置都得分最高。 更高的推理力度改变的是智能体所求助的信息来源，而其回答的质量保持不变。 因此，脚手架决定了智能体如何工作，而模型决定了它能走多远。

paragraphs.en: The design of a skill is a decision that the engineer has to make deliberately. Where a workflow is already established, fixing it inside a skill costs nothing, as the search strategies and the solver interface show. Where no such workflow exists, leaving the decision to the agent lets it explore designs that a script or template could not include, as the unit cells the agent drew without a given example show. In general, designing a skill pipeline entails a trade-off between reliability and exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 技能的设计是工程师必须审慎做出的决策。 在已有工作流程的情况下，将其固化在技能中没有任何代价，正如搜索策略与求解器接口所展示的那样。 在不存在此类工作流程的情况下，把决策留给智能体可以让它探索脚本或模板无法涵盖的设计，正如智能体在没有给定示例的情况下绘制出的晶胞所展示的那样。 总体而言，设计技能流水线需要在可靠性与探索之间进行权衡。

paragraphs.en: The study of language-model agents in acoustics is still at an early stage. More sophisticated agent designs, more demanding applications, and complete simulation workflows remain to be examined. To retain control over such systems, it will be essential to measure the contribution of each new element and how the elements work together. This work can serve as a starting point for isolating the elements of an agent and measuring their impact.
paragraphs.zh: 声学中语言模型智能体的研究仍处于早期阶段。 更复杂的智能体设计、要求更高的应用以及完整的仿真工作流仍有待考察。 为了保持对此类系统的控制，必须衡量每个新要素的贡献以及各要素如何协同工作。 这项工作可以作为分离智能体各要素并衡量其影响的起点。

paragraphs.en: Where a prompt asks when a fault occurs, both the response and the reference are lists of type, onset and offset ( Mesaros et al., 2016 ) . For each reference event, the grader considers the unmatched predictions of the same type and selects the one whose onset is closest. No optimal assignment is computed ( Kuhn, 1955 ) . Each reference therefore absorbs at most one prediction, and a duplicate detection becomes a false positive ( Everingham et al., 2010 ) . A match is counted if onset and offset are both within a tolerance
